review.concepts: Reviewed elimination, multiplicity, monotone validity, prefix-boundary eligibility, partition and feasibility search, endpoint equality, sweep batching, and DP take/skip dependency proofs.
review.numericContracts: Long used for sums, counts, and rewards. First-missing-positive checks bounds before indexing; consecutive sequence uses long neighbors; median widens before addition; exact-prefix subtraction guards long overflow; stair count limits n to 91; coin amount explicitly bounded to keep sentinel/allocation arithmetic defined.
review.mutation: All owned snippets preserve input except explicitly documented firstMissingPositive placement. Interval sorting copies rows or reference lists; no original row is written.
review.hardMethods: Range merge counting counts original-index cross-half pairs and uses monotone value bounds; skyline batches equal-coordinate events with multiplicity; median searches shorter-array cuts with long sentinels; weighted jobs finds compatible prefix counts before take/skip.

representativeChecks.details: All29 standalone snippet classes compiled and executed representative and boundary assertions. Equivalent testKotlin fields are supplied for the parent compiler harness; not independently executed by this author.

methods.name: medianSorted
methods.oracle: Sort concatenated arrays and compute middle value(s); includes empty sides, duplicates, and int extremes.

methods.name: countRangeSum
methods.oracle: Enumerate every nonempty contiguous range with long running sums; includes negatives and selected int extremes.

methods.name: skyline
methods.oracle: At each unique endpoint, scan every building active on the right-open span; compare canonical height-change key points.

methods.name: maxJobReward
methods.oracle: Enumerate every subset of up to8 jobs; reject pairwise overlaps; maximize reward including empty selection.

methods.name: trap
methods.oracle: For every position scan complete left and right maxima and sum exact long contributions.
